ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, there are two straight lines intersecting, the angle label near the intersection at the upper left is 124°, and the adjacent angle label at the upper right is ∠1. The 124° angle and ∠1 share the same vertex, and share one side slanting upward to the right; their other two sides extend leftward and rightward respectively along the same straight line, and are opposite rays. Then reason: Therefore 124° and ∠1 form a pair of adjacent supplementary angles, and the sum of the measures of adjacent supplementary angles is 180°. So ∠1 = 180° - 124° = 56°.
